title: Arendt's The Origins of Totalitarianism
summary: Hannah Arendt argued that Nazism and Stalinism were a new form of government that used terror against whole populations, and traced their roots to antisemitism and imperialism.
why: A founding work for understanding totalitarian rule.

notes.problem: Source gives first publication in English in 1951 with the citation '[1951, New York: Schocken]'; the UK 'Burden of Our Time' edition is not in the source.
